events.verdict: Wagner (ORL) makes contact to the ball, causing Thomas (MIL) to lose possession.
Turner (MIL) contests Banchero's (ORL) dunk attempt and the contact that occurs is marginal.
Wagner (ORL) jumps vertically and absorbs the ensuing contact with Kuzma (MIL) during his layup attempt.
Porter Jr. (MIL) reaches across Bane's (ORL) front during the drive and the contact is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Wagner (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Wagner turns into Porter Jr. (MIL) and initiates illegal contact during his driving shot attempt.
Sims (MIL) reaches in and makes illegal contact to Suggs' (ORL) arm.
Banchero (ORL) rests an arm against Turner (MIL) after the release of his jump shot attempt and the marginal contact does not impact his ability to return to the floor.
Thomas (MIL) releases the pass to Kuzma (MIL), establishing the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Thomas (MIL) steps into Suggs' (ORL) lower body, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) brings the ball into Turner's (MIL) leg, causing it to become loose.
